message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout that left us in the dark for hours. Instead of panicking, I grabbed my trusty flashlight and powered up our phones with a portable charger. We ended up playing board games by flashlight, and it was a blast! It felt good to unplug and rediscover some low-tech fun with the family. Sometimes, a little darkness can spark the best memories. What's your favorite way to pass the time when the lights go out?
